title: GLM-5 and Scribe v2 join the model lineup
summary:
GLM-5 and Scribe v2 joined the lineup, video dimensions got more useful, and Node 23 stopped being a startup obstacle.

The `glm` text model now routes to GLM-5, with a new `glm-5` alias; the existing `glm-4.7` and `glm-4p7` aliases resolve to it too. ElevenLabs Scribe v2 was added as `scribe` on the Whisper-compatible transcription endpoint, with text, JSON, and detailed JSON responses.

Video generation now uses supplied dimensions to choose aspect ratio and resolution for Veo, Seedance, and Wan, and to size Grok Video requests. Wan 2.6 also gained text-to-video and image-to-video support through its new provider route.

The tier explanation now uses the color of the current tier. API-key permission toggles and the audio model’s “Select all” control also show a pointer cursor.

daily.title: GLM moves to version 5
daily.text: Use `glm-5` for GLM-5 text generation. The existing `glm`, `glm-4.7`, and `glm-4p7` aliases now resolve to GLM-5 too. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=glm-5).

daily.title: Scribe v2 transcribes audio
daily.text: Send audio to `/v1/audio/transcriptions` with `scribe` for speech-to-text. Choose `text`, `json`, or `verbose_json` responses; structured output can include words and segments. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=scribe).

daily.title: More control over video
daily.text: Supply width and height to guide video aspect ratio and resolution across Veo, Seedance, Grok Video, and Wan 2.6. Wan 2.6 also supports text-to-video and image-to-video. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
